intro: Bring home both elegance and function with the Opulent buffet table—crafted for easy storage, beautiful contrast, and timeless dining room charm that elevates your everyday dining experience.

features.title: Refined, luxurious style
features.text: With clean lines and neutral tones, this buffet table brings quiet sophistication and complements both traditional and modern dining spaces.

features.title: Beige glass top
features.text: The beige glass top adds refined contrast to the darker walnut-toned base, enhancing visual interest while offering a durable surface.

features.title: Effortless storage access
features.text: Spacious compartments make it easy to organize dinnerware, cutlery, or table linens—everything is within reach, yet tucked away neatly.

features.title: Built for lasting strength
features.text: Made from a sturdy Sheesham wood frame and oak legs, the buffet table stands firm and offers long-lasting structure with a touch of warmth.

features.title: Easy to clean, lifted look
features.text: With generous ground clearance, it’s easy to keep the floor beneath tidy—ideal for effortless upkeep and a lighter, airier appearance.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Opulent V2 Wooden Buffet Table
